chunks: O believers, obey God and His Messenger, and do not turn away from him when you hear (him speak);
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command believers to do regarding obedience to God and the Messenger?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inseparable link between obedience to Allah and the Prophet, often interpreted as a mandate for following the Imams who embody the Prophet's authority. The warning against turning away while listening highlights the spiritual danger of negligence during the period of active revelation and guidance, a principle extended to the era of the Major Occultation. It serves as a foundational text for the concept of Wilayat al-Faqih, emphasizing that true faith requires continuous, attentive compliance with divine authority.
